messages:
amanda: FYI PartnerCorp ran a bulk retry after key rotation and we have ~34k units of late-arrival usage causing a reconciliation drift. can someone triage? :eyes:
raj: on it. can you attach a sample payload and the partner batch ids?
marta: is this an automated replay or manual operator retries?
amanda: looks manual. partner ops rotated their signing key and retried windows 2026-03-14 through 2026-03-16. some retries landed after our daily aggregation closed.
marketplace-bot: ALERT: ingest.late_batches PartnerCorp > 750 (region=us-west-2)
devon: partner here. we rotated keys and retried; some retries got 401 and were queued for later delivery. apologies for the churn.
raj: ok that tracks. do we have logs with `signature_verification_failed`? that will explain requeue vs immediate process.
amanda: yes — a slice of webhooks show `signature_verification_failed` and were enqueued to partner-retry-queue. many were processed after the 23:59:59 UTC hourly cut.
marta: consequence: missed those batches in hourly_rollup. we should build a controlled backfill flow: 1) identify missed partner_batch_ids, 2) re-insert into rollup_reprocess queue with reason=late_retry, 3) surface any ledger delta to finance for manual review.
devon: we can pause partner-side retries for the affected window until you confirm backfill is complete. we'll hold for ~90 minutes.
raj: operational checks: reprocessing must be idempotent by partner_batch_id; confirm dedupe exists and add guard rails for duplicate re-sends.
amanda: rollup uses `rollup_state` to dedupe on partner_batch_id; if a batch never made it in, reprocessing will apply. we need to avoid double-apply if partner resends during backfill.
marta: i'll draft the reprocess SQL. also we should flag any batches where entitlement TTL < 7 days or units exceed a safety cap.
raj: agree. add `signature_verification_result` to export for traceability and a `max_units` cap (e.g., 250k) to force manual approval.
amanda: exporting CSV now with columns: partner_batch_id,timestamp,units,original_status,signature_verification_result. pushing to s3://redwood-partner-backfills/partnercorp/2425001111-missed.csv (internal link).
devon: got it. holding retries and will send signed confirmation after backfill.
marta: draft reprocess — staging run first; please review:
```
-- reprocess late partner retries into hourly rollup (staging)
INSERT INTO hourly_rollup_reprocess (partner_batch_id, raw_payload, reprocess_reason, requested_by, reprocess_run_id)
SELECT i.partner_batch_id, i.raw_payload, 'partner_late_retry', 'marta', gen_uuid() FROM ingest_log i
JOIN s3_csv('s3://redwood-partner-backfills/partnercorp/2425001111-missed.csv') c ON i.partner_batch_id = c.partner_batch_id
WHERE i.partner = 'PartnerCorp' AND i.processed = true AND i.processed_at > '2026-03-15T23:59:59Z'
AND c.units <= 250000;
```
raj: notes before staging: 1) record reprocess_run_id and persist mapping to partner_batch_id 2) run in staging and compute ledger_diff = new_ledger_total - baseline; post results 3) alert if ledger_delta > 0.1% for partner.
amanda: i've flagged 2 batches >250k units for manual review. pushing stakeholder note to finance.
devon: partner approved the hold. we'll freeze outbound retries for the two affected windows and confirm when locked.
marta: running staging now; will post staging diff in ~30m. plan to run in production only after sign-off.
raj: i'll sit watch and add metric alerts: `partner.ledger.delta` and `ingest.late.batch.count`. also ensure the reprocess job sets a tombstone for partner_batch_id to avoid double-apply if partner retries later.
amanda: preparing partner comms: short message to ops channel and finance: "We're reprocessing a small set of late batches for PartnerCorp caused by signing-key retries. Expected net impact: small credit < $X. We'll confirm when backfill completes and provide ledger diff."
devon: good. i'll send partner ops confirmation when backfill is kicked.
marta: staging run complete: ledger delta for staging was +33,812 units (matches sample). uploading staging diff to s3://redwood-partner-backfills/partnercorp/2425001111-staging-diff.csv
raj: looks good in staging. go/no-go: amanda / finance sign-off?
amanda: finance okayed for production since net credit under threshold and we've flagged large batches. proceeding in 10m.
devon: partner-side hold remains in place. ready to confirm when you start.
marta: kicking prod job now with reprocess_run_id=run_2425001111_01. will post final ledger_delta.
raj: monitoring. alert thresholds in place.
amanda: prod done: final ledger delta = +34,101 units. finance notified and partner confirmation requested. closing thread once partner acknowledges. :white_check_mark:
